shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin is trading in a tight range above $80,000, with Ethereum remaining stable, while some altcoins like Uniswap, Terra Luna Classic, and SUI have seen notable gains.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded their sixth consecutive week of net inflows, signaling sustained institutional demand, and large stablecoin outflows are interpreted as institutional repositioning.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has jumped nine points to 47 (Neutral), indicating a recovery in sentiment, though retail enthusiasm still lags institutional flows.
The US annual inflation rate rose to 3.3% in March with forecasts for further increases, which is expected to keep Federal Reserve interest rates steady and limit crypto upside.
Geopolitical tensions involving Iran and the US continue to cause market uncertainty alongside upcoming events like the US Senate vote on the new Fed Chairman and the CLARITY Act review.
